title: (RHSA-2021:0871) Moderate: Red Hat Integration Debezium 1.4.2 security update
portal_summary:
An update for Debezium MongoDB connector is now available for Red Hat Integration.

Red Hat Product Security has rated this update as having a security impact of Moderate. A Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) base score, which gives a detailed severity rating, is available for each vulnerability from the CVE link(s) in the References section.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Integration|Red Hat Integration|Text-Only Advisories|x86_64
portal_description:
MongoDB is a higly-scalable document database. The Debezium MongoDB connector includes Java driver to access a MongoDB database.

Security Fix(es):

* mongodb-driver: mongo-java-driver: client-side field level encryption not verifying KMS host name (CVE-2021-20328)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
